sections.title: 1. Introduction
paragraphs: Moina GmbH, operating as Aquacubes ("we," "our," or "us"), is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or use our products and services.

sections.title: 2. Information We Collect
list: Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number, shipping address, billing information
Order Information: Order history and status, linked to your email address (no account or password required)
Device Information: IP address, browser type, operating system, device identifiers
Usage Data: Pages visited, time spent, features used, app interaction data
Aquaculture Data: System performance data, sensor readings (anonymized and used for product improvement)

sections.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
list: Send transactional emails and marketing communications (with consent)
Ensure system security and prevent fraud

sections.title: 4. Sharing Your Information
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal information. We may share data with:
list: Legal authorities when required by law

sections.title: 5. Data Security
paragraphs: We use industry-standard encryption (SSL/TLS) and security measures. Your payment information is processed by PCI-compliant third parties and never stored on our servers.

sections.title: 7. Cookies
paragraphs: We use essential cookies for site functionality and analytics cookies to improve our service. You can manage cookie preferences in your browser settings.

sections.title: 8. Third-Party Services
paragraphs: Our site uses a trusted third-party payment processor (Stripe) to handle transactions. This service has its own privacy policy.

sections.title: 9. Children's Privacy
paragraphs: Our services are not directed at children under 16. We do not knowingly collect data from children.

sections.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy periodically. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated date.
